statement: The exact statement the operation issues for name "R & T GENERAL CONSTRUCTION" (EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), read-only, 40 s bound for plan capture only).
planShape: IDENTICAL for scoped and unscoped, cold and warm. Bitmap Index Scan on all five name trigram indexes (contractors display/legal/dba, licenses licensee_name_raw/dba_name_raw) -> BitmapOr -> Bitmap Heap Scan with the full per-field rule as Filter -> Unique -> nested-loop lookups on licenses_contractor_idx and contractors_pkey -> scope function scan. No sequential scan anywhere.
earlierObservation: Before the full per-field rule was moved inside the prefilter, ~2,000 index candidates each also paid two join lookups (contractors_pkey + licenses_contractor_idx); that variant measured 19-25 s and one warm run of 2.6 s, of which 2.3 s was 37 cold reads of the licensee index (~64 ms per read).
finding: The query does the minimum possible work for this predicate with the existing indexes. Latency is governed by whether ~8,000 index/heap pages are resident: ~0.23 s resident, 15-19 s not resident. Pages searched 10-20 minutes earlier were already non-resident again. The same cold/warm swing was measured for the single common word "Allied" (9-11 s and one >30 s cold; 0.09-0.34 s warm).
notDone: No timeout was raised, no index/schema added, no resources purchased, no publication weakened.
